_about: Provenance for craft knowledge. Titles and authors are facts (not copyrightable). We register sources so cards can cite where an abstract craft feature was learned. We DO NOT reproduce protected text; only abstract heuristics, claims, and failure modes are extracted. `license` and `copyright_note` record what may and may not be copied, and flag the German/EU check the brief calls for (US public-domain status does not settle EU/DE status).

sources.title: The Living Handbook of Narratology
sources.creator: Hamburg University (eds.)
sources.notes: Concept definitions (focalization, order/duration/frequency, tellability). Summarize concepts; do not paste article text.

sources.title: The Art of Dramatic Writing
sources.creator: Lajos Egri
sources.notes: Extract abstract heuristics: premise as testable proposition, character contradiction, orchestration of forces. No text reproduction.
sources.copyright_note: US: possibly PD via non-renewal (verify). DE/EU: author died 1967, so protected until 2037 (life+70). Treat as in-copyright in the EU; abstract features only.

sources.title: Techniques of the Selling Writer
sources.creator: Dwight V. Swain
sources.notes: Extract scene/sequel structure and motivation-reaction units as abstract patterns.
sources.copyright_note: In-copyright (author died 1992). EU protected until 2062. Abstract features only.

sources.title: Dialogue: The Art of Verbal Action
sources.creator: Robert McKee
sources.notes: Extract the idea of dialogue as action with objective/subtext/turn. No text reproduction.

sources.title: How Fiction Works
sources.creator: James Wood
sources.notes: Extract free-indirect discourse and the mechanics of narrative distance as abstract craft.

sources.title: The Art of Fiction
sources.creator: John Gardner
sources.notes: Extract 'continuous dream' and psychic-distance gradations as abstract concepts.
sources.copyright_note: In-copyright (author died 1982). EU protected until 2052. Abstract features only.

sources.title: Reading Like a Writer
sources.creator: Francine Prose
sources.notes: Extract close-reading discipline and specificity heuristics. No text reproduction.

sources.title: Standard Ebooks (public-domain corpus)
sources.creator: Standard Ebooks
sources.notes: Source of US-public-domain texts for corpus analysis (annotation, not reproduction into prompts wholesale).
sources.copyright_note: US public domain. EU/DE status must be verified per author death date before ingesting any specific title.
